The '''Pokémon hunter''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンハンター''' ''Pokémon Hunter'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY063|A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!]]''. He captures other people's Pokémon as well as wild ones for a living.

The Pokémon hunter was mentioned several times by [[Dr. White]] when he was pleading with [[Beatrice]] to not try and battle him. He was also mentioned to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} as the owner of the trap that injured {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. Later, he attacked [[James]] and {{MTR}}, kidnapping Meowth as well as {{TP|Jessie|Pumpkaboo}} and {{TP|James|Inkay}}. Ash, {{an|Serena}}, and {{an|Bonnie}} agreed to help James rescue them, but were having trouble holding off the Pokémon hunter's {{p|Rhyperior}}. However, [[Jessie]] and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} arrived just in time to rescue everyone, and the Pokémon hunter was defeated and arrested.
